svg.title: Known-best packing of 260 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=260 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete d2d5dd9 rational centre/half-angle certificates, unchanged at 0e76d9f, read exactly from the retained source files. Finite construction feasibility only; no KKT, local minimum, same-packing, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.
